# steps

1. open `http://localhost:4712/`
2. click the button `Load sample data`
3. if a survey popup appears, close it
4. scroll down to the monthly table
5. sort the table by the Total column so the biggest month comes first
6. open the row with the highest total and read out its details
7. go back up to the monthly consumption trend chart and click the blue line at its highest point, the June to August peak
8. click the green line at its lowest point
9. hide the Commercial series using the legend, then bring it back
10. open the display options with the little gear icon and pick the orange colour
11. scroll to Regional distribution and click the tallest bar
12. press the button under the chart that goes to the next region, twice
13. in Key terms click the Arabic word `طاقة` and explain what it says below
14. open the details panel, move to the Notes tab using the keyboard arrow keys, then to Sources
15. close the panel
